javascript
        // ==========================================
        // 👑【核心優化】：自動糾錯與經驗學習閉環系統 (前端版) [1.1]
        // ==========================================
        function runStockAI(attempt = 1, maxAttempts = 3, errorHistory = "") {
            const text = $("#userInput").val().trim();
            const key = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            if (!text || !key) return;

            // 💡 若為第二輪以上的嘗試，帶著歷史報錯引導 AI 修正
            let promptToSend = text;
            if (attempt > 1) {
                promptToSend = text + `\n\n【⚠️ 嚴重警告】：你上一輪產生的 SQL 執行失敗，請必須改正！\n【錯誤/警告訊息】：\n${errorHistory}\n【正確欄位限制】：必須使用繁體「專家實戰總分」、「實戰標籤」、「股本億」。[日期]欄位是INT（例如20260717），不可使用DATEADD。請重新思考並只輸出 \`\`\`sql ... \`\`\` 程式碼塊，絕對不要有任何多餘解釋！`;
            }

            const enhancedPrompt = promptToSend + ` (規範：1.禁止縮寫欄位。2.必須使用完整名稱：均價黃金交叉次數, OBV金叉總數。3.嚴禁使用中括號。4.嚴禁在欄位後加別名如 [產業分類]分類。)`;

            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: "https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/StockAI.aspx/TranslateToSQL",
                data: JSON.stringify({ userSpeech: enhancedPrompt, userApiKey: key }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: (res) => {
                    if (res.d.success) {
                        fetchStockData(res.d.sql, false, text, attempt, maxAttempts, errorHistory);
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        function runStockAI1(attempt = 1, maxAttempts = 3, errorHistory = "") {
            const text = $("#userInput").val().trim();
            if (!text) return Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入專家指令", "info");

            Swal.fire({ title: `專家運算中... (嘗試 ${attempt}/${maxAttempts})`, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });

            // 💡 若為第二輪以上的嘗試，帶著歷史報錯引導 AI 修正
            let promptToSend = text;
            if (attempt > 1) {
                promptToSend = text + `\n\n【⚠️ 嚴重警告】：你上一輪產生的 SQL 執行失敗，請必須改正！\n【錯誤/警告訊息】：\n${errorHistory}\n【正確欄位限制】：必須使用繁體「專家實戰總分」、「實戰標籤」、「股本億」。[日期]欄位是INT（例如20260717），不可使用DATEADD。請重新思考並只輸出 \`\`\`sql ... \`\`\` 程式碼塊，絕對不要有任何多餘解釋！`;
            }

            const strictText = promptToSend + " (規則：使用 StockScore 表，欄位嚴禁別名，不准用中括號，日期必須過濾 MAX(日期)，僅輸出 SELECT 語句)";

            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: "https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/StockAI.aspx/TranslateToSQL1",
                data: JSON.stringify({ userSpeech: strictText }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: (res) => {
                    if (res.d.success) {
                        console.log(`專家產出 SQL (嘗試 #${attempt}):`, res.d.sql);
                        fetchStockData(res.d.sql, true, text, attempt, maxAttempts, errorHistory);
                    } else {
                        Swal.fire("錯誤", res.d.msg, "error");
                    }
                },
                error: () => { Swal.close(); Swal.fire("失敗", "無法連線至 StockAI.aspx", "error"); }
            });
        }

        // 修改後的資料撈取中轉函數 (傳遞閉環變數)
        function fetchStockData(sql, isExpert, originalPrompt, attempt = 1, maxAttempts = 3, errorHistory = "") {
            const db = $("#dbSelect").val();
            const $btns = $(".main-btn");

            $btns.prop("disabled", true).css("opacity", "0.5");

            Swal.fire({
                title: `<i class="fas fa-sync fa-spin text-cyan-400"></i> 指令執行中 (嘗試 ${attempt}/${maxAttempts})`,
                html: `
                <div class="text-left">
                    <div class="mb-2 text-xs text-yellow-400">正在查詢資料庫：${db}</div>
                    <div class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mb-1">完整的 SQL 指令：</div>
                    <textarea id="executingSql" class="w-full h-32 text-[10px] p-2 bg-black border border-gray-700 text-cyan-300 rounded font-mono" readonly>${sql}</textarea>
                    <div class="mt-2 text-center text-xs text-gray-400 anim-pulse">伺服器數據檢索中...</div>
                </div>
            `,
                background: '#050a15',
                color: '#fff',
                allowOutsideClick: false,
                showConfirmButton: false,
                didOpen: () => {
                    Swal.showLoading();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        executeAjaxCall(sql, db, isExpert, $btns, originalPrompt, attempt, maxAttempts, errorHistory);
                    }, 50);
                }
            });
        }

        // 核心 AJAX 執行與錯誤攔截引擎
        function executeAjaxCall(sql, db, isExpert, $btns, originalPrompt, attempt, maxAttempts, errorHistory) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: "DataService2.aspx/ExecuteSQL",
                data: JSON.stringify({ sql: sql, db: db, pwd: "2157" }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (res) {
                    let rawData = res.d;

                    // 1. 語法級別錯誤攔截 ➔ 自動觸發糾錯閉環 [1.1]
                    if (typeof rawData === "string" && rawData.indexOf("錯誤") !== -1) {
                        let errorMsg = rawData;
                        console.warn(`❌ [SQL 執行期報錯]：\n${errorMsg}`);
                        
                        if (attempt < maxAttempts) {
                            let nextAttempt = attempt + 1;
                            let packedError = `【失敗的 SQL】:\n${sql}\n\n【錯誤原因】:\n${errorMsg}`;
                            Swal.close();
                            
                            // 呼叫相應的 AI 函數進行下一輪重試
                            if (isExpert) {
                                runStockAI1(nextAttempt, maxAttempts, packedError);
                            } else {
                                runStockAI(nextAttempt, maxAttempts, packedError);
                            }
                        } else {
                            Swal.close();
                            // 超過重試次數，彈出最終錯誤警告
                            Swal.fire({
                                title: "SQL 指令錯誤",
                                html: `
                                <div class="text-left">
                                    <div class="bg-red-100 p-3 rounded text-red-700 text-xs font-bold mb-3 border-l-4 border-red-500">嘗試了 ${maxAttempts} 次仍未能成功收斂。</div>
                                    <div class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mb-1">出錯的最後一版指令如下：</div>
                                    <textarea class="w-full h-40 text-[10px] p-2 bg-gray-100 border text-black font-mono" readonly>${sql}</textarea>
                                </div>
                            `,
                                icon: "error",
                                width: '600px'
                            });
                        }
                        return;
                    }

                    try {
                        if (typeof rawData === "string" && rawData.lastIndexOf(']') !== -1) {
                            rawData = rawData.substring(0, rawData.lastIndexOf(']') + 1);
                        }
                        const data = JSON.parse(rawData);
                        
                        if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0) {
                            // 2. 數據膨脹防禦 (防範忘記限制日期而倒出歷史數據) [1.1]
                            if (data.length > 200 && originalPrompt) {
                                let feedback = `執行成功，但回傳了多達 ${data.length} 筆數據。您可能忘了限制最新日期！請在 WHERE 條件中務必限制日期為最新的一天：日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM MasterStockAnalysis)，或者使用 TOP 50 限制行數！`;
                                if (attempt < maxAttempts) {
                                    Swal.close();
                                    if (isExpert) runStockAI1(attempt + 1, maxAttempts, feedback);
                                    else runStockAI(attempt + 1, maxAttempts, feedback);
                                    return;
                                }
                            }
                            
                            // 🎉 🎉 成功渲染！
                            Swal.close();
                            renderTable(data, isExpert);
                            
                            // 👑 【自動進化核心】：當執行成功，且是經由 AI 語音生成時，將本輪成功的實戰經驗寫入 AIEngineeringKB 庫中！ [1.1]
                            if (originalPrompt) {
                                saveExperienceToKB(originalPrompt, sql, errorHistory);
                            }
                        } else {
                            // 3. 零數據防禦 (防範條件太嚴或名稱打錯) [1.1]
                            let feedback = "執行成功，但回傳了 0 筆數據。這代表您的過濾條件可能太嚴格，或者股票名稱有錯。請不要使用等號(=)，改用 模糊查詢（名稱 LIKE N'%關鍵字%'）來尋找！";
                            if (attempt < maxAttempts && originalPrompt) {
                                Swal.close();
                                if (isExpert) runStockAI1(attempt + 1, maxAttempts, feedback);
                                else runStockAI(attempt + 1, maxAttempts, feedback);
                            } else {
                                Swal.close();
                                Swal.fire("查無資料", "SQL 執行成功，但條件下查無結果。", "info");
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        Swal.close();
                        Swal.fire("解析失敗", "回傳非 JSON 格式內容", "error");
                    }
                },
                error: () => {
                    Swal.close();
                    Swal.fire("連線失敗", "伺服器無回應", "error");
                },
                complete: () => {
                    $btns.prop("disabled", false).css("opacity", "1");
                }
            });
        }

        // 👑【經驗儲存函數】：將成功的 AI 調試結果背景默默寫入 AIEngineeringKB 資料庫 [1.1, 2.1]
        function saveExperienceToKB(promptText, successfulSql, errors) {
            // 安全引號轉義，防止 SQL 注入與字串破裂
            let escapedPrompt = promptText.replace(/'/g, "''");
            let escapedSql = successfulSql.replace(/'/g, "''");
            let escapedErrors = errors ? errors.replace(/'/g, "''") : "";

            let sqlCommand = `EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_SaveToAIEngineeringKB 
                @UserPrompt = N'${escapedPrompt}', 
                @CorrectSQL = N'${escapedSql}', 
                @ErrorHistory = N'${escapedErrors}';`;

            // 靜默執行寫入，完全無感
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: "DataService2.aspx/ExecuteSQL",
                data: JSON.stringify({ sql: sqlCommand, db: "stockchangedate", pwd: "2157" }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function() {
                    console.log("🚀 [自動進化] 成功！本輪成功的 AI 實戰經驗已安全寫入 AIEngineeringKB 知識庫。");
                }
            });
        }

                ' 在背景模糊搜尋使用者提到的股票名稱
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(代號) AS 代號, RTRIM(名稱) AS 名稱 " &
                                   "FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis " &
                                   "WHERE @speech LIKE '%' + RTRIM(名稱) + '%'"
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@speech", userSpeech)
                    conn.Open()
                    Using dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                        Dim matches As New List(Of String)()
                        While dr.Read()
                            matches.Add($"股票名稱『{dr("名稱")}』對應的 [代號] 必須為 '{dr("代號")}'")
                        End While
                        If matches.Count > 0 Then
                            hint &= vbCrLf & "【⚠️ 系統盤中個股對齊提示 - 必須嚴格遵守】： " & vbCrLf
                            For Each m In matches
                                hint &= "- " & m & vbCrLf
                            Next
                            hint &= "請在撰寫 SQL 時，若涉及上述股票，WHERE 條件【必須】精確對齊為 代號 = '代號'，嚴禁使用任何幻覺或簡體代號！" & vbCrLf
                        End If
                    End Using
                End Using
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
            ' 靜默防呆
        End Try
        Return hint
    End Function

    ' =========================================================

    ' =========================================================
    Private Shared Function GetAIEngineeringKBSamples() As String
        Dim samples As String = ""
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 5 UserPrompt, CorrectSQL FROM stockchangedate.dbo.AIEngineeringKB ORDER BY QueryCount DESC"

sql\n" & dr("CorrectSQL").ToString() & "\n
" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf

                        End If
                    End Using
                End Using
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
            ' 靜默防呆
        End Try
        Return samples
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [功能 1]：雲端/Gemini 轉譯 (大寬表 MasterStockAnalysis)
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL(ByVal userSpeech As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 動態注入個股提示與歷史成功經驗
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一個 T-SQL 專家。目標表：MasterStockAnalysis。" & vbCrLf &
                "【⚠️ 繁簡體與字體極重要規則】： " & vbCrLf &
                "1. 欄位名稱必須 100% 使用繁體中文，嚴禁使用簡體字！" & vbCrLf &
                "   - 必須使用 '專家實戰總分'，嚴禁寫成 '专家實戰總分' 或 '专家实战总分'！" & vbCrLf &
                "   - 必須使用 '實戰標籤'，嚴禁寫成 '实戰標籤' 或 '实战标签'！" & vbCrLf &
                "   - 必須使用 '股本億'，嚴禁寫成 '股本亿'！" & vbCrLf &
                "【核心規範】： " & vbCrLf &
                "1. 嚴禁使用 DATEADD 或日期函數，[日期] 欄位是 INT 數字。" & vbCrLf &
                "2. 處理『連續幾天』的需求時，必須使用 LAG() 視窗函數，禁止使用自我連接(JOIN)。" & vbCrLf &
                "3. 取得前幾名僅限用 SELECT TOP X，嚴禁重複出現 DISTINCT。" & vbCrLf &
                "4. 集中度欄位請用 [集中度1日]。" & vbCrLf &
                "5. 僅輸出 SQL 代碼，不准有任何解釋文字。" & vbCrLf &
                GetStockCodeHint(userSpeech) & vbCrLf &
                GetAIEngineeringKBSamples() & vbCrLf &
                "需求：" & userSpeech

            Dim aiSql As String = CallOllama(prompt)
            
            ' 💡 核心優化：強制呼叫 CleanSqlResult 進行後台自動清洗！ [2.1]
            Dim cleanedSql As String = CleanSqlResult(aiSql)
            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = cleanedSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "轉譯出錯: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [功能 2]：專家選股 語音轉 SQL (使用 StockScore 表)
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL1(ByVal userSpeech As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim realCols As String = "A.[名稱],A.[代號],A.[產業分類],A.[股本億],A.[盤中現價],A.[盤中漲幅],A.[盤中總量],A.[價五日乖離],A.[量倍數],A.[OBV分],A.[價均分],A.[技術分],A.[籌碼分],A.[量能分],A.[專家實戰總分],A.[實戰標籤],A.[日期]"

            ' 動態注入個股提示與歷史成功經驗 [2.1]
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一個 T-SQL 專家。請針對 [StockScore] 表撰寫 SQL。" & vbCrLf &
                "【⚠️ 繁簡體與字體極重要規則】： " & vbCrLf &
                "1. 欄位名稱必須 100% 使用繁體中文，嚴禁使用簡體字（例如必須用 專家實戰總分、實戰標籤、股本億）！" & vbCrLf &
                "【輸出規範】：只輸出 SQL 語句，禁止解釋。" & vbCrLf &
                "【數值門檻規範】： " & vbCrLf &
                "- [籌碼分]：滿分通常很低，若提到『籌碼好』或篩選時，請使用 >= 5 (嚴禁使用 60)。" & vbCrLf &
                "- [專家實戰總分]：提到『高分』時建議使用 > 25。" & vbCrLf &
                "- [OBV分]、[價均分]、[技術分]：若需篩選，預設使用 >= 5。" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf &
                "【模式導向 (Select Case)】：" & vbCrLf &
                "Case 1: 若提到『連三升』" & vbCrLf &
                "   -> 使用 WITH Ranked 模板" & vbCrLf &
                "Case 2: 查詢『單一股票』" & vbCrLf &
                "   -> SELECT ... WHERE A.代號 = N'代號'" & vbCrLf &
                "Case 3: 一般篩選" & vbCrLf &
                "   -> SELECT TOP 100 " & realCols & " FROM StockScore A WHERE A.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM StockScore) AND A.[籌碼分] >= 5" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf &
                GetStockCodeHint(userSpeech) & vbCrLf &
                GetAIEngineeringKBSamples() & vbCrLf &
                "【使用者指令】：" & userSpeech

            Dim aiSql As String = CallOllama(prompt)

            ' 💡 核心優化：強制呼叫 CleanSqlResult 進行後台自動清洗！
            Dim cleanedSql As String = CleanSqlResult(aiSql)

            ' --- 智慧修正：防止 AI 在 Case 1 判斷失敗 ---
            If userSpeech.Contains("連") AndAlso Not cleanedSql.ToUpper().Contains("WITH") Then
                cleanedSql = "WITH Ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) as rn FROM StockScore) " &
                     "SELECT DISTINCT TOP 100 " & realCols & " FROM Ranked A " &
                     "INNER JOIN Ranked B ON A.代號 = B.代號 AND B.rn = 2 " &
                     "INNER JOIN Ranked C ON A.代號 = C.代號 AND C.rn = 3 " &
                     "WHERE A.rn = 1 AND A.專家實戰總分 > B.專家實戰總分 AND B.專家實戰總分 > C.專家實戰總分"
            End If

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = cleanedSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "專家引擎失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' =========================================================
    ' 👑【核心與盾牌二】：常見欄位幻覺與繁簡體自動清洗對齊器 [2.1]
    ' =========================================================
    Private Shared Function CleanSqlResult(ByVal sql As String) As String
        Dim res = sql.Replace("
sql", "").Replace("
", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()

        ' 1. 自動繁簡體轉換
        res = res.Replace("专家", "專家").Replace("专", "專")
        res = res.Replace("实战", "實戰").Replace("实", "實")
        res = res.Replace("标签", "標籤").Replace("标", "標").Replace("签", "籤")
        res = res.Replace("亿", "億")

        ' 2. 👑 自動將 AI 常見的欄位與別名幻覺，對位修正為資料庫 100% 正確的繁體欄位！ [2.1]
        res = res.Replace("交易量", "盤中總量")
        res = res.Replace("最新價格", "盤中現價")
        res = res.Replace("最新價", "盤中現價")
        res = res.Replace("收盤價", "盤中現價")
        res = res.Replace("資料 日期", "日期")
        res = res.Replace("資料日期", "日期")
        res = res.Replace("交易日期", "日期")
        res = res.Replace("交易[日期]", "日期")
        res = res.Replace("OBV金叉總數", "obv累積金叉次數")
        res = res.Replace("OBV累積金叉次數", "obv累積金叉次數")
        res = res.Replace("OBV_累積金叉", "obv累積金叉次數")
        res = res.Replace("股票代号", "代號").Replace("股票代號", "代號").Replace("股票名稱", "名稱")

        ' 3. 修復雙重 DISTINCT 幻覺
        res = res.Replace("DISTINCT TOP 100 DISTINCT", "DISTINCT TOP 100")
        res = res.Replace("DISTINCT DISTINCT", "DISTINCT")

        ' 4. 移除中括號後的別名贅字 (]分類, ]日期)
        res = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(res, "\][\u4e00-\u9fa5]+", "]")

        ' 5. 強行將 AI 寫的 DATEADD 比較改掉
        If res.Contains("DATEADD") Then
            res = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(res, "AND\s+\[?日期\]?\s*>=?\s*DATEADD\(.*?\)", "")
            res = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(res, "WHERE\s+\[?日期\]?\s*>=?\s*DATEADD\(.*?\)", "WHERE 1=1")
        End If

        ' 6. 移除中括號
        res = res.Replace("[", " ").Replace("]", " ")

        Return res.Trim()
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [圖表數據]：獲取單股趨勢
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetStockTrendData(ByVal stockId As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim list As New List(Of Object)
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 10 名稱, 代號, 日期, 盤中現價, 專家實戰總分 " &
                                   "FROM MasterStockAnalysis WHERE 代號 = @id ORDER BY 日期 DESC"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", stockId)
                conn.Open()
                Dim dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                While dr.Read()
                    list.Add(New With {
                        .date = dr("日期").ToString(),
                        .price = Convert.ToDouble(dr("盤中現價")),
                        .goldCount = Convert.ToDouble(dr("專家實戰總分"))
                    })
                End While
            End Using
            list.Reverse()
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [功能 4]：全市場產業熱力診斷
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetIndustryAnalysis(ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim rows As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql = "SELECT TOP 10 [產業分類], ROUND(AVG(CAST([一日漲幅] AS FLOAT)), 2) as [平均漲幅], AVG([均價黃金交叉次數]) as [平均金叉] " &
                          "FROM [View_AI_Stock_Pro] WHERE [日期] = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM winnewdate) " &
                          "GROUP BY [產業分類] ORDER BY [平均漲幅] DESC"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("industry", dr("產業分類").ToString())
                        row.Add("avg_change", dr("平均漲幅"))
                        row.Add("avg_gold", dr("平均金叉"))
                        rows.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using

            Dim prompt = "你是一位策略師。請根據這份產業平均漲幅數據，點評今日資金流向。" & New JavaScriptSerializer().Serialize(rows)
            Dim analysis = CallOllama(prompt)
            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = analysis, .rawData = rows}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [功能 5]：歷史勝率回測
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetWinRateAnalysis(ByVal stockId As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim historyData As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 240 b.[日期], b.[成交價], w.[均價黃金交叉次數] " &
                                   "FROM [basicinfo] AS b " &
                                   "INNER JOIN [winnewdate] AS w ON b.[代號] = w.[股票代號] AND b.[日期] = w.[日期] " &
                                   "WHERE b.[代號] = @id " &
                                   "ORDER BY b.[日期] ASC"

                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", stockId)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("d", dr("日期").ToString())
                        row.Add("p", Val(dr("成交價").ToString()))
                        row.Add("g", Val(dr("均價黃金交叉次數").ToString()))
                        historyData.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using

            If historyData.Count = 0 Then Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "無歷史資料"}

            Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位量化分析師。請分析這份一年期的歷史數據 JSON。" &
                "【格式規範】： " &
                "1. 嚴禁使用 Markdown 標題 (禁止 ###)。 " &
                "2. 嚴禁使用 LaTeX 數學符號 (禁止 $ 符號、限制 \\geq, \\approx, \\text{})。 " &
                "3. 請直接使用中文描述，例如用『大於等於』代替 >=，用『大約』代替 ≈。 " &
                "4. 數字請保持純數字格式。 " &
                "5. 請使用純文字換行即可，不要有任何特殊排版符號。" &
                "d=日期, p=價格, g=金叉次數。 " &
                "【任務】：1.找出所有 g >= 7 的日期。 2.計算出現訊號後 5 天內的漲跌。 " &
                "3.如果這一年內『完全沒有』g >= 7，請改為分析 g >= 4 (當前水平) 出現後的表現。 " &
                "4.總結勝率並給出 80 字內操作建議。 數據：" & jss.Serialize(historyData)

            Dim aiReport = CallOllama(prompt)
            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = aiReport}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [核心引擎]：本地 Ollama
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    Private Shared Function CallOllama(ByVal prompt As String) As String
        Dim modelName As String = "qwen2.5:7b"
        Try
            Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create("http://localhost:11434/api/generate"), HttpWebRequest)
            request.Method = "POST" : request.ContentType = "application/json" : request.Timeout = 90000
            Dim body = New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"model", modelName}, {"prompt", prompt}, {"stream", False}}
            Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                sw.Write(New JavaScriptSerializer().Serialize(body))
            End Using
            Using resp As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Dim resObj = New JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(New StreamReader(resp.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd())
                Return resObj("response").ToString().Trim()
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
            Throw New Exception("AI 引擎連線失敗: " & ex.Message)
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [備用引擎]：Ollama Gemma/Qwen
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    Private Shared Function CallOllama1(ByVal prompt As String) As String
        Dim modelName As String = "qwen2.5:7b"
        Try
            Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create("http://localhost:11434/api/generate"), HttpWebRequest)
            request.Method = "POST" : request.ContentType = "application/json" : request.Timeout = 120000

            Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
            Dim body = New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"model", modelName}, {"prompt", prompt}, {"stream", False}}

            Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                sw.Write(jss.Serialize(body))
            End Using

            Using resp As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Dim resText = New StreamReader(resp.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd()
                Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)

                If resObj IsNot Nothing AndAlso resObj.ContainsKey("response") Then
                    Return resObj("response").ToString().Trim()
                Else
                    Throw New Exception("Ollama 服務忙碌中，未回傳有效 response，請稍後再試。")
                End If
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
            Throw New Exception("連線失敗: " & ex.Message)
        End Try
    End Function

-- 🏆 常用話術 1：專家總分連三升 (WITH Ranked 視窗函數)
INSERT INTO dbo.AIEngineeringKB (UserPrompt, CorrectSQL, ErrorHistory, QueryCount)
VALUES (
    N'找專家實戰總分大於 35 且今天分數連三升的強勢股',
    N'WITH Ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) as rn FROM MasterStockAnalysis) SELECT DISTINCT TOP 100 A.名稱, A.代號, A.專家實戰總分, A.日期, A.實戰標籤 FROM Ranked A INNER JOIN Ranked B ON A.代號 = B.代號 AND B.rn = 2 INNER JOIN Ranked C ON A.代號 = C.代號 AND C.rn = 3 WHERE A.rn = 1 AND A.專家實戰總分 > 35.0 AND A.專家實戰總分 > B.專家實戰總分 AND B.專家實戰總分 > C.專家實戰總分 ORDER BY A.專家實戰總分 DESC;',
    N'自進化成功', 2
);

python
import re
import pyodbc

# 資料庫連線字串 - 請與您原本的檔案保持一致
CONN_STR = 'DRIVER={SQL Server};SERVER=pc048000110;DATABASE=stockchangedate;Trusted_Connection=yes'

def handle_stock_code_lookup(msg_text):
    """
    👑【核心功能】：自動解析語音/文字，跨庫模糊查詢股票代號並返回 Ready-to-use 提示 [Operational Manual]
    """
    # 💡 採用先進正則，相容 "創意代號"、"查詢台積電的股票代號"、"幫我查創意的代號" [Operational Manual]
    match = re.search(r"(?:幫我查|查詢|查|找)?\s*([^\s的]+?)\s*(?:的)?\s*(?:股票)?代號", msg_text.strip())
    if not match:
        return None
        
    stock_name = match.group(1).strip()
    
    # 跨庫至 MasterStockAnalysis 進行模糊比對，精確對位名稱 [Database Architecture]
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            sql = """
            SELECT TOP 1 RTRIM(代號) AS 代號, RTRIM(名稱) AS 名稱 
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis 
            WHERE 名稱 LIKE ? 
            ORDER BY 日期 DESC
            """
            cursor.execute(sql, (f"%{stock_name}%",))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row:
                code = row[0]
                name = row[1]
                # 返回一體化引導提示，讓用戶直接複製即可輸入說明 [Operational Manual]
                return f"📡 【{name}】的股票代號為：【{code}】\n\n💡 戰情提示：\n您可以直接輸入【{code}說明】來獲取該股的實時深度解盤與共振圖表！"
            else:
                return f"🔍 戰情室搜尋：在資料庫中查無名稱包含『{stock_name}』的標的，請確認名稱是否正確。"
    except Exception as e:
        return f"⚠️ 系統提示：個股代號查詢失敗，原因：{e}"

# ==========================================
# 👑【核心新增】：單股名稱對齊代號查詢引擎 (防止記不住代號之實戰痛點) [Operational Manual]
# ==========================================
def handle_stock_code_lookup(msg_text):
    """
    自動解析語音/文字，跨庫模糊查詢股票代號並返回 Ready-to-use 提示 [Operational Manual]
    """
    import re
    import pyodbc
    
    # 資料庫連線字串 - 完美對齊您的 pc048000110 伺服器 [Operational Manual]
    local_conn_str = 'DRIVER={SQL Server};SERVER=pc048000110;DATABASE=stockchangedate;Trusted_Connection=yes'
    
    # 💡 採用先進正則，相容 "創意代號"、"查詢台積電的股票代號"、"幫我查創意的代號" [Operational Manual]
    match = re.search(r"(?:幫我查|查詢|查|找)?\s*([^\s的]+?)\s*(?:的)?\s*(?:股票)?代號", msg_text.strip())
    if not match:
        return None
        
    stock_name = match.group(1).strip()
    
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(local_conn_str, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            sql = """
            SELECT TOP 1 RTRIM(代號) AS 代號, RTRIM(名稱) AS 名稱 
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis 
            WHERE 名稱 LIKE ? 
            ORDER BY 日期 DESC
            """
            cursor.execute(sql, (f"%{stock_name}%",))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row:
                code = row[0]
                name = row[1]
                # 返回一體化引導提示，讓用戶直接複製即可輸入說明 [Operational Manual]
                return f"📡 【{name}】的股票代號為：【{code}】\n\n💡 戰情提示：\n您可以直接輸入【{code}說明】來獲取該股的實時深度解盤與共振圖表！"
            else:
                return f"🔍 戰情室搜尋：在資料庫中查無名稱包含『{stock_name}』的標的，請確認名稱是否正確。"
    except Exception as e:
        return f"⚠️ 系統提示：個股代號查詢失敗，原因：{e}"

def callback():
    signature = request.headers['X-Line-Signature']
    body = request.get_data(as_text=True)
    try:
        handler.handle(body, signature)
    except InvalidSignatureError:
        abort(400)
    return 'OK'

        return event.source.group_id
    elif event.source.type == 'room':
        return event.source.room_id
    return event.source.user_id

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆 本檔案為【50+ 組 SQL 範本自動化導入工具】
# 它會直連您的本地 IIS 伺服器，解析 myword1.html?id=82 中的 JS 陣列，並將所有範本全自動寫入 AIEngineeringKB 經驗庫中！ [1.1, 2.1]

import re
import requests
import pyodbc
import urllib3

# 關閉 self-signed SSL 憑證警告 (防止 https 阻擋)
urllib3.disable_warnings(urllib3.exceptions.InsecureRequestWarning)

# ==========================================
# 【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
# 💡 優先使用 localhost 進行安全高速直連，避免公網與 ngrok 穿透限制 [1.1]
TARGET_URL = "http://localhost:8888/excelimport/myword1.html?id=82"
# 如果 localhost 埠口不同，也可以解開下方 duckdns 公網註冊：
# TARGET_URL = "https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/myword1.html?id=82"

CONN_STR = 'DRIVER={SQL Server};SERVER=pc048000110;DATABASE=stockchangedate;Trusted_Connection=yes'

def fetch_and_import_templates():
    print(f"🚀 正在連接本地網頁取得 50+ 組 SQL 範本: {TARGET_URL}")
    try:
        # 下載網頁原始碼 (忽略 SSL 憑證檢查)
        response = requests.get(TARGET_URL, verify=False, timeout=15)
        response.encoding = 'utf-8'
        html_content = response.text
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 網頁讀取失敗 (請確認您的 IIS 伺服器已啟動且 Port 8888 正常)：{e}")
        return

    # 💡 2. 使用高效彈性正則，精確抓取 JS 陣列中的 { cat: '...', title: '...', sql: `...` } 結構
    # 支援單引號、雙引號以及 ES6 模板字串反引號 (``)，相容鍵值帶/不帶引號格式 [1.1]
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'\{\s*(?:cat|["\']cat["\'])\s*:\s*["\'](.*?)["\']\s*,\s*(?:title|["\']title["\'])\s*:\s*["\'](.*?)["\']\s*,\s*(?:sql|["\']sql["\'])\s*:\s*(?:`([\s\S]*?)`|["\']([\s\S]*?)["\'])\s*\}',
        re.DOTALL
    )
    
    matches = pattern.findall(html_content)
    if not matches:
        print("⚠️ 未能在網頁中匹配到標準的 { cat, title, sql } 範本結構。")
        print("💡 請確認網頁源碼中的 sqlLib 陣列格式是否為標準型態。")
        return

    print(f"📊 成功偵測到 {len(matches)} 組 SQL 戰情範本！準備開始自動化大一統寫入...")
    
    success_count = 0
    fail_count = 0
    
    # 3. 建立資料庫連線並批次寫入 AIEngineeringKB [2.1]
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            
            for item in matches:
                cat = item[0].strip()
                title = item[1].strip()
                # 處理反引號或單雙引號抓取到的 SQL 內文
                sql = item[2].strip() if item[2] else item[3].strip()
                
                # 👑 依據長官指示對齊欄位：UserPrompt = cat + title, CorrectSQL = sql [1.1]
                user_prompt = cat + title
                correct_sql = sql
                
                if not user_prompt or not correct_sql:
                    continue
                
                try:
                    # 呼叫自動進化預存程序進行寫入或增量更新 [2.1]
                    cursor.execute(
                        "EXEC dbo.sp_SaveToAIEngineeringKB @UserPrompt = ?, @CorrectSQL = ?",
                        (user_prompt, correct_sql)
                    )
                    success_count += 1
                except Exception as db_err:
                    print(f"❌ 寫入失敗 -> 需求: {user_prompt} | 錯誤: {db_err}")
                    fail_count += 1
            
            conn.commit()
            
        print("\n" + "=" * 45)
        print(f"🎉 🎉 批次導入完成！結果大捷！")
        print(f"📊 成功寫入/更新：{success_count} 筆範本")
        print(f"⚠️ 失敗：{fail_count} 筆")
        print("=" * 45)
        print("📡 您的 AI 經驗知識庫 [AIEngineeringKB] 已成功充實！AI 轉譯能力已大步進化！")
        
    except Exception as conn_err:
        print(f"❌ 資料庫連線失敗 (請確認 SQL Server 已啟動且 ConnString 正確)：{conn_err}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    fetch_and_import_templates()

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆 本檔案為【50+ 組 SQL 範本雙重解耦自動化導入工具】
# 內建雙重解耦解析法，100% 免疫 JS 陣列中任何換行、逗號與縮進干擾！ [1.1, 2.1]

import re
import requests
import pyodbc
import urllib3

# 關閉 self-signed SSL 憑證警告 (防止 https 阻擋)
urllib3.disable_warnings(urllib3.exceptions.InsecureRequestWarning)

# ==========================================
# 【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
# 💡 優先使用 https 配合 localhost 進行直連，解決 10054 與 SSL 握手衝突
TARGET_URL = "https://localhost:8888/excelimport/myword1.html?id=82"
# 如果 localhost 埠口不同，也可以解開下方 duckdns 公網註冊：
# TARGET_URL = "https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/myword1.html?id=82"

CONN_STR = 'DRIVER={SQL Server};SERVER=pc048000110;DATABASE=stockchangedate;Trusted_Connection=yes'

def fetch_and_import_templates():
    print(f"🚀 正在連接本地網頁取得 50+ 組 SQL 範本: {TARGET_URL}")
    try:
        # 下載網頁原始碼 (忽略 SSL 憑證檢查)
        response = requests.get(TARGET_URL, verify=False, timeout=15)
        response.encoding = 'utf-8'
        html_content = response.text
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 網頁讀取失敗 (請確認您的 IIS 伺服器已啟動且 Port 8888 正常)：{e}")
        return

    # 💡 2. 【雙重解耦解析法 - 第一步】：先掃描並抓出所有包含 cat 和 sql 關鍵字的 { ... } 區塊 [1.1]
    block_pattern = re.compile(r'\{[^{}]*?cat\s*:[\s\S]*?sql\s*:[\s\S]*?\}', re.DOTALL)
    blocks = block_pattern.findall(html_content)
    
    if not blocks:
        print("⚠️ 未能在網頁中匹配到任何大括號 {} 包裹的範本區塊。")
        return

    matches = []
    
    # 💡 3. 【雙重解耦解析法 - 第二步】：在每個獨立區塊中，單獨提取 cat, title, sql (100% 免疫逗號與換行) [1.1]
    for block in blocks:
        cat_match = re.search(r'cat\s*:\s*["\'](.*?)["\']', block)
        title_match = re.search(r'title\s*:\s*["\'](.*?)["\']', block)
        # sql 欄位支援 反引號 (``) 或單雙引號
        sql_match = re.search(r'sql\s*:\s*(?:`([\s\S]*?)`|["\']([\s\S]*?)["\'])', block)
        
        if cat_match and title_match and sql_match:
            cat = cat_match.group(1).strip()
            title = title_match.group(1).strip()
            # 優先讀取反引號內容，否則讀取單雙引號內容
            sql = sql_match.group(1).strip() if sql_match.group(1) else sql_match.group(2).strip()
            matches.append((cat, title, sql))

    if not matches:
        print("⚠️ 雖抓到大括號區塊，但在區塊內部提取 cat, title 或 sql 欄位時失敗。")
        return

    print(f"📊 成功偵測並提取出 {len(matches)} 組標準 SQL 戰情範本！準備開始自動化寫入...")
    
    success_count = 0
    fail_count = 0
    
    # 4. 建立資料庫連線並批次寫入 AIEngineeringKB [2.1]
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            
            for item in matches:
                cat = item[0]
                title = item[1]
                sql = item[2]
                
                # 👑 依據長官指示對齊欄位：UserPrompt = cat + title, CorrectSQL = sql [1.1]
                user_prompt = cat + title
                correct_sql = sql
                
                if not user_prompt or not correct_sql:
                    continue
                
                try:
                    # 呼叫自動進化預存程序進行寫入或增量更新 [2.1]
                    cursor.execute(
                        "EXEC dbo.sp_SaveToAIEngineeringKB @UserPrompt = ?, @CorrectSQL = ?",
                        (user_prompt, correct_sql)
                    )
                    success_count += 1
                except Exception as db_err:
                    print(f"❌ 寫入失敗 -> 需求: {user_prompt} | 錯誤: {db_err}")
                    fail_count += 1
            
            conn.commit()
            
        print("\n" + "=" * 45)
        print(f"🎉 🎉 批次導入完成！結果大捷！")
        print(f"📊 成功寫入/更新：{success_count} 筆範本")
        print(f"⚠️ 失敗：{fail_count} 筆")
        print("=" * 45)
        print("📡 您的 AI 經驗知識庫 [AIEngineeringKB] 已成功充實！AI 轉譯能力已大步進化！")
        
    except Exception as conn_err:
        print(f"❌ 資料庫連線失敗 (請確認 SQL Server 已啟動且 ConnString 正確)：{conn_err}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    fetch_and_import_templates()

                "2. 處理『連續幾天』的需求時，必須使用 LAG() 視窗函數，禁止使用自我連接(JOIN)。" & vbCrLf & _
                "3. 取得前幾名僅限用 SELECT TOP X，嚴禁重複出現 DISTINCT。" & vbCrLf & _
                "4. 集中度欄位請用 [集中度1日]。" & vbCrLf & _
                "5. 僅輸出 SQL 代碼，不准有任何解釋文字。" & vbCrLf & _
                GetStockCodeHint(userSpeech) & vbCrLf & _
                GetAIEngineeringKBSamples() & vbCrLf & _
                "需求：" & userSpeech

            Dim aiSql As String = CallOllama(prompt)
            
            ' 呼叫 CleanSqlResult 進行後台自動清洗！
            Dim cleanedSql As String = CleanSqlResult(aiSql)
            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = cleanedSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "轉譯出錯: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [功能 2]：專家深度診斷 (20 種任務策略)
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function AnalyzeExpertTask(ByVal stockDataJson As String, ByVal taskId As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 💡【對齊】：加上行尾連接符 _，確保舊版編譯器正常通過 [2.1]
            Dim systemPrompt As String = "你是一位頂尖量化交易員與籌碼專家。請根據數據回答，規範如下：" & vbCrLf & _
                "1. 嚴禁使用 LaTeX (如 \ge, \approx, $) 或 Markdown 標題(###)。" & vbCrLf & _
                "2. 專家總分 = OBV分+價均分+技術分+籌碼分+量能分。" & vbCrLf & _
                "3. 判定標籤：追高(乖離8-18%)、量價齊揚(站均量>=7且漲幅>3%)、大戶鎖碼(庫存增幅>2%)。" & vbCrLf & _
                "4. 簡潔條列式，100字內。"

            ' 任務庫
            Dim taskLib As New Dictionary(Of String, String) From {
                {"A1", "全方位健康檢查：給出 1-10 投資信心分。"},
                {"A2", "實戰標籤解析：解釋目前標籤對操作的意義。"},
                {"A3", "總分拆解分析：指出該股最強與最弱的環節。"},
                {"A4", "短線爆發潛力：分析是否具備短線快速拉升條件。"},
                {"B1", "大戶鎖碼分析：判斷籌碼（1-60日）是否趨於集中。"},
                {"B2", "法人動向追蹤：判斷法人共識程度。"},
                {"B3", "籌碼分深挖：判斷是主力吸籌還是獲利了結。"},
                {"B4", "資券使用率預警：判斷散戶與專業投資者的對抗強度。"},
                {"C1", "K-D 多週期分析：對比日、週、月趨勢階段。"},
                {"C2", "MACD 動能分析：分析價格動能是否衰減。"},
                {"C3", "乖離率風險評估：建議回調價格區間。"},
                {"C4", "量能突破判定：判斷量能是否支撐目前漲幅。"},
                {"D1", "進場時機建議：應採『分批買進』還是『等待回調』？"},
                {"D2", "止損止盈建議：建議合理的止損位與目標價。"},
                {"D3", "波段持有分析：該股是否適合波段操作。"},
                {"D4", "隱藏風險挖掘：尋找數據中的轉弱訊號。"},
                {"E1", "量價背離偵測：檢查是否存在量價或籌碼背離。"},
                {"E2", "潛伏低位偵測：搜尋是否符合低位金叉潛伏特徵。"},
                {"E3", "過熱警報分析：判斷是否為典型的主力出貨訊號。"},
                {"E4", "極速反轉預測：判斷是否處於空轉多的臨界點。"}
            }

            Dim taskDesc = If(taskLib.ContainsKey(taskId), taskLib(taskId), "綜合診斷")
            Dim finalPrompt = systemPrompt & vbCrLf & "【任務】：" & taskDesc & vbCrLf & "【股票數據】：" & stockDataJson

            Dim result = CallOllama(finalPrompt)
            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = result, .taskName = taskId}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [圖表數據]：獲取單股趨勢
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetStockTrendData(ByVal stockId As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim list As New List(Of Object)
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 10 名稱, 代號, 日期, 盤中現價, 專家實戰總分 " & _
                                   "FROM MasterStockAnalysis WHERE 代號 = @id ORDER BY 日期 DESC"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", stockId)
                conn.Open()
                Dim dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                While dr.Read()
                    list.Add(New With {
                        .date = dr("開期").ToString(),
                        .price = Convert.ToDouble(dr("盤中現價")),
                        .goldCount = Convert.ToDouble(dr("專家實戰總分"))
                    })
                End While
            End Using
            list.Reverse()
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [功能 4]：全市場產業熱力診斷
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetIndustryAnalysis(ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim rows As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql = "SELECT TOP 10 [產業分類], ROUND(AVG(CAST([一日漲幅] AS FLOAT)), 2) as [平均漲幅], AVG([均價黃金交叉次數]) as [平均金叉] " & _
                          "FROM [View_AI_Stock_Pro] WHERE [日期] = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM winnewdate) " &
                          "GROUP BY [產業分類] ORDER BY [平均漲幅] DESC"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("industry", dr("產業分類").ToString())
                        row.Add("avg_change", dr("平均漲幅"))
                        row.Add("avg_gold", dr("平均金叉"))
                        rows.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using

            Dim prompt = "你是一位策略師。請根據這份產業平均漲幅數據，點評今日資金流向。" & New JavaScriptSerializer().Serialize(rows)
            Dim analysis = CallOllama(prompt)
            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = analysis, .rawData = rows}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [功能 5]：歷史勝率回測
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetWinRateAnalysis(ByVal stockId As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim historyData As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 240 b.[日期], b.[成交價], w.[均價黃金交叉次數] " & _
                                   "FROM [basicinfo] AS b " & _
                                   "INNER JOIN [winnewdate] AS w ON b.[代號] = w.[股票代號] AND b.[日期] = w.[日期] " &
                                   "WHERE b.[代號] = @id " & _
                                   "ORDER BY b.[日期] ASC"

                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", stockId)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row : New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("d", dr("日期").ToString())
                        row.Add("p", Val(dr("成交價").ToString()))
                        row.Add("g", Val(dr("均價黃金交叉次數").ToString()))
                        historyData.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using

            If historyData.Count = 0 Then Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "無歷史資料"}

            Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
            ' 💡【對齊】：加上行尾連接符 _，確保舊版編譯器正常通過 [2.1]
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位量化分析師。請分析這份一年期的歷史數據 JSON。" & _
                "【格式規範】： " & _
                "1. 嚴禁使用 Markdown 標題 (禁止 ###)。 " & _
                "2. 嚴禁使用 LaTeX 數學符號 (禁止 $ 符號、限制 \\geq, \\approx, \\text{})。 " & _
                "3. 請直接使用中文描述，例如用『大於等於』代替 >=，用『大約』代替 ≈。 " & _
                "4. 數字請保持純數字格式。 " & _
                "5. 請使用純文字換行即可，不要有任何特殊排版符號。" & _
                "d=日期, p=價格, g=金叉次數。 " & _
                "【任務】：1.找出所有 g >= 7 的日期。 2.計算出現訊號後 5 天內的漲跌。 " & _
                "3.如果這一年內『完全沒有』g >= 7，請改為分析 g >= 4 (當前水平) 出現後的表現。 " & _
                "4.總結勝率並給出 80 字內操作建議。 數據：" & jss.Serialize(historyData)

            Dim aiReport = CallOllama(prompt)
            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = aiReport}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [核心引擎]：本地 Ollama (使用 qwen2.5:7b)
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    Private Shared Function CallOllama(ByVal prompt As String) As String
        Dim modelName As String = "qwen2.5:7b"
        Try
            Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create("http://localhost:11434/api/generate"), HttpWebRequest)
            request.Method = "POST" : request.ContentType = "application/json" : request.Timeout = 90000
            Dim body = New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"model", modelName}, {"prompt", prompt}, {"stream", False}}
            Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                sw.Write(New JavaScriptSerializer().Serialize(body))
            End Using
            Using resp As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Dim resObj = New JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(New StreamReader(resp.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd())
                Return resObj("response").ToString().Trim()
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
            Throw New Exception("AI 引擎連線失敗: " & ex.Message)
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [備用引擎]：Ollama Gemma/Qwen
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    Private Shared Function CallOllama1(ByVal prompt As String) As String
        Dim modelName As String = "qwen2.5:7b"
        Try
            Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create("http://localhost:11434/api/generate"), HttpWebRequest)
            request.Method = "POST" : request.ContentType = "application/json" : request.Timeout = 120000

            Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
            Dim body = New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"model", modelName}, {"prompt", prompt}, {"stream", False}}

            Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                sw.Write(jss.Serialize(body))
            End Using

            Using resp As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Dim resText = New StreamReader(resp.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd()
                Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)

                If resObj IsNot Nothing AndAlso resObj.ContainsKey("response") Then
                    Return resObj("response").ToString().Trim()
                Else
                    Throw New Exception("Ollama 服務忙碌中，未回傳有效 response，請稍後再試。")
                End If
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
            Throw New Exception("連線失敗: " & ex.Message)
        End Try
    End Function

    ' =========================================================
    ' 👑【核心與盾牌二】：常見欄位與繁簡體自動清洗對齊器 [2.1]
    ' =========================================================
    Private Shared Function CleanSqlResult(ByVal sql As String) As String
        Dim res = sql.Replace("
sql", "").Replace("
", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()

        ' 1. 自動繁簡體轉換
        res = res.Replace("专家", "專家").Replace("专", "專")
        res = res.Replace("实战", "實戰").Replace("实", "實")
        res = res.Replace("标签", "標籤").Replace("标", "標").Replace("签", "籤")
        res = res.Replace("亿", "億")

        ' 2. 👑 自動將 AI 常見的欄位與別名幻覺，對位修正為資料庫 100% 正確的繁體欄位！ [2.1]
        res = res.Replace("交易量", "盤中總量")
        res = res.Replace("最新價格", "盤中現價")
        res = res.Replace("最新價", "盤中現價")
        res = res.Replace("收盤價", "盤中現價")
        res = res.Replace("資料 日期", "日期")
        res = res.Replace("資料日期", "日期")
        res = res.Replace("交易日期", "日期")
        res = res.Replace("交易[日期]", "日期")
        res = res.Replace("OBV金叉總數", "obv累積金叉次數")
        res = res.Replace("OBV累積金叉次數", "obv累積金叉次數")
        res = res.Replace("OBV_累積金叉", "obv累積金叉次數")
        res = res.Replace("股票代号", "代號").Replace("股票代號", "代號").Replace("股票名稱", "名稱")

        ' 💡【核心修正二】：將 SQL 註解 '--' 修正為 VB.NET 註解單引號 ''''，排除編譯崩潰！ [2.1]
        res = res.Replace("代號 LIKE N'%聯發科%'", "名稱 LIKE N'%聯發科%'")
        res = res.Replace("代號 LIKE '%聯發科%'", "名稱 LIKE N'%聯發科%'")

        ' 3. 修復雙重 DISTINCT 幻覺
        res = res.Replace("DISTINCT TOP 100 DISTINCT", "DISTINCT TOP 100")
        res = res.Replace("DISTINCT DISTINCT", "DISTINCT")

        ' 4. 移除中括號後的別名贅字 (]分類, ]日期)
        res = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(res, "\][\u4e00-\u9fa5]+", "]")

        ' 5. 強行將 AI 寫的 DATEADD 比較改掉
        If res.Contains("DATEADD") Then
            res = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(res, "AND\s+\[?日期\]?\s*>=?\s*DATEADD\(.*?\)", "")
            res = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(res, "WHERE\s+\[?日期\]?\s*>=?\s*DATEADD\(.*?\)", "WHERE 1=1")
        End If

        ' 6. 移除中括號
        res = res.Replace("[", " ").Replace("]", " ")

        Return res.Trim()
    End Function

    ' --- [專家選股]：語音轉 SQL (使用 StockScore 表) ---
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL1(ByVal userSpeech As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 1. 定義 StockScore 的標準欄位 (確保與您的資料庫一致)
            Dim realCols As String = "A.[名稱],A.[代號],A.[產業分類],A.[股本億],A.[盤中現價],A.[盤中漲幅],A.[盤中總量],A.[價五日乖離],A.[量倍數],A.[OBV分],A.[價均分],A.[技術分],A.[籌碼分],A.[量能分],A.[專家實戰總分],A.[實戰標籤],A.[日期]"

            ' 💡【對齊】：加上行尾連接符 _，確保舊版編譯器正常通過 [2.1]
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一個 T-SQL 專家。請針對 [StockScore] 表撰寫 SQL。" & vbCrLf & _
                "【輸出規範】：只輸出 SQL 語句，禁止解釋。" & vbCrLf & _
                "【數值門檻規範】： " & vbCrLf & _
                "- [籌碼分]：滿分通常很低，若提到『籌碼好』或篩選時，請使用 >= 5 (嚴禁使用 60)。" & vbCrLf & _
                "- [專家實戰總分]：提到『高分』時建議使用 > 25。" & vbCrLf & _
                "- [OBV分]、[價均分]、[技術分]：若需篩選，預設使用 >= 5。" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                "【模式導向 (Select Case)】：" & vbCrLf & _
                "Case 1: 若提到『連三升』" & vbCrLf & _
                "   -> 使用 WITH Ranked 模板" & vbCrLf & _
                "Case 2: 查詢『單一股票』" & vbCrLf & _
                "   -> SELECT ... WHERE A.代號 = N'代號' ORDER BY A.日期 DESC" & vbCrLf & _
                "Case 3: 一般篩選" & vbCrLf & _
                "   -> SELECT TOP 100 " & realCols & " FROM StockScore A WHERE A.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM StockScore) AND A.[籌碼分] >= 5" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                GetStockCodeHint(userSpeech) & vbCrLf & _
                GetAIEngineeringKBSamples() & vbCrLf & _
                "【使用者指令】：" & userSpeech

            ' 3. 調用本地 Ollama (或 Gemini)
            Dim aiSql As String = CallOllama(prompt)

            ' 4. 清理雜質
            Dim cleanedSql As String = CleanSqlResult(aiSql)

            ' --- 智慧修正：防止 AI 在 Case 1 判斷失敗 ---
            If userSpeech.Contains("連") AndAlso Not cleanedSql.ToUpper().Contains("WITH") Then
                cleanedSql = "WITH Ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) as rn FROM StockScore) " & _
                     "SELECT DISTINCT TOP 100 " & realCols & " FROM Ranked A " & _
                     "INNER JOIN Ranked B ON A.代號 = B.代號 AND B.rn = 2 " & _
                     "INNER JOIN Ranked C ON A.代號 = C.代號 AND C.rn = 3 " & _
                     "WHERE A.rn = 1 AND A.專家實戰總分 > B.專家實戰總分 AND B.專家實戰總分 > C.專家實戰總分"
            End If

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = cleanedSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "專家引擎失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

sql
SELECT DISTINCT TOP 100

    專家實戰總分, 
    實戰標籤, 
    股本億, 
    日期

    AND 代號 IN (
        SELECT RTRIM(代號)

        WHERE 日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM MasterStockAnalysis)
          AND 五日成交價交叉成功 = 1                               -- 3. 價格金叉
          AND 五日交叉成功 = 1                                     -- 4. OBV金叉
          AND 五日三大法人交叉成功 = 1                              -- 5. 法人金叉
          AND 五日外資交叉成功 = 1                                 -- 6. 外資金叉
          AND 五日投信交叉成功 = 1                                 -- 7. 投信金叉
    )
ORDER BY 
    專家實戰總分 DESC;

sql

在 SQL Server 中，`UserPrompt` 是 `NVARCHAR`（雙位元 Unicode 字串） [2.1]。 然而，我們在拼接模糊查詢的百分比符號時，漏掉了代表 Unicode 的 `N` 前綴（寫成了 `'%'` 而非 `N'%'`） [2.1]。 * 影響：這導致 SQL Server 會將整個拼接後的搜尋條件 `_speech` 隱式轉換為非萬國碼的 `VARCHAR`（單位元字串）。 * 對於「台積電」、「鴻海」這種 2 或 3 個字元的短中文，轉換可能勉強能對位。 * 但對於像 `'七維共振儀表板七維共振 ✕ 股權大戶吃貨加權'` 這類長達 20 個字元、且含有特殊符號 `✕` 的複雜 Unicode 長字串，隱式轉型為非 Unicode 的 `VARCHAR` 會直接導致語意比對在資料庫底層判定「未命中（Mismatch）」！這就是為什麼直通失效、被迫走入 AI 轉譯的主因！ --- ### 🛠️ 解決方案：在後台 SQL 強制加上 `N` 前綴 我們必須在兩個直通函數的百分比符號前，強制加上 `N` 前綴，鎖定為 `NVARCHAR` 比對，100% 確保繁體中文與特殊符號的安全握手！ 請開啟您的 `StockAI.aspx.vb`，將這兩個函數替換為以下這個 `N` 前綴安全版：
vb
    ' =========================================================
    ' 👑【終極修正】：強效 N 前綴對齊器 (100% 確保萬國碼特殊符號與長中文精確命中) [2.1]
    ' =========================================================
    Private Shared Function LookupKBMatch(ByVal userSpeech As String) As String
        Dim matchedSql As String = ""
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                ' 💡【核心修正】：在百分比符號前強制加上 N，轉為 NVARCHAR，徹底解決 Unicode 轉型斷層問題！ [2.1]
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 1 CorrectSQL " & _
                                   "FROM stockchangedate.dbo.AIEngineeringKB " & _
                                   "WHERE UserPrompt LIKE N'%' + @speech + N'%' " & _
                                   "ORDER BY QueryCount DESC, ID DESC"
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@speech", userSpeech.Trim())
                    conn.Open()
                    Dim result = cmd.ExecuteScalar()
                    If result IsNot Nothing Then
                        matchedSql = result.ToString().Trim()
                        
                        ' 💡 自動遞增使用次數
                        IncrementQueryCount(userSpeech.Trim())
                    End If
                End Using
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
            ' 靜默防呆
        End Try
        Return matchedSql
    End Function

    ' 💡 同步將遞增更新語法的百分比符號前也加上 N 前綴 [2.1]
    Private Shared Sub IncrementQueryCount(ByVal userSpeech As String)
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "UPDATE stockchangedate.dbo.AIEngineeringKB " & _
                                   "SET QueryCount = QueryCount + 1, LastUsedDate = GETDATE() " & _
                                   "WHERE UserPrompt LIKE N'%' + @speech + N'%'"
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@speech", userSpeech.Trim())
                    conn.Open()
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
                End Using
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
        End Try
    End Sub

    ' =========================================================
    ' 👑【核心與功能二】：智慧清理與 SELECT 補齊器 [2.1]
    ' =========================================================
    Private Shared Function CleanSqlResult(ByVal sql As String) As String
        Dim res = sql.Replace("
sql", "").Replace("
", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()

        ' 💡 【核心新增】：自動偵測是否缺少 SELECT (先移除註解干擾，對齊前端跑檔邏輯) [2.1]
        Dim tempSql As String = res.ToUpper()
        Dim testSql As String = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(tempSql, "/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", "").Trim()
        
        If Not String.IsNullOrEmpty(testSql) AndAlso _
           Not testSql.StartsWith("SELECT") AndAlso _
           Not testSql.StartsWith("WITH") AndAlso _
           Not testSql.StartsWith("EXEC") Then
            ' 如果沒有 SELECT 開頭，在原始程式碼 (保留註解狀態) 最前方補上 SELECT [2.1]
            res = "SELECT " & res
        End If

        ' (以下原有的繁簡體自動轉換與清洗邏輯維持不變) [2.1]
        res = res.Replace("专家", "專家").Replace("专", "專")

    -- 🏆 核心三：60日均分長線趨勢診斷 [2.1]
    (CASE

        WHEN SCH.實戰總分_ma60 BETWEEN 0.0 AND 9.99 THEN N'🌤️ 長線溫和'
        ELSE N'⛈️ 長線空頭'
    END) AS [長線分數趨勢],

    -- 60M 即時指標 (僅作為顯示，不設任何限制，100% 確保全市場個股出現) [2.1]
    T.[最新60M_K],

    -- 結合 V7.0 快照表，掌握週線防守位 (改用 LEFT JOIN 防禦) [2.1]

    F.最新EPS中位數 AS [FactSet預估EPS],

    -- 雙維度股性 DNA 最佳持股天數與勝率並排比對 [2.1]
    T.[S15_最佳勝率] AS [S15_最高勝率(%)],
    T.[S15_最佳天數] AS [S15_最佳持股天數(天)],
    T.[S30_最佳勝率] AS [S30_最高勝率(%)],
    T.[S30_最佳天數] AS [S30_最佳持股天數(天)],

    -- 為了前端長條圖讀取的 7 個交叉分值 [2.1]
    SCH.實戰總分黃金交叉次數 AS [實戰總分共振分],
    AC.成交價黃金交叉次數 AS [價格共振分],

    T.具體概念

    -- 第一層：日線寬表與即時庫 JOIN 運算 (改為由外層直接連接實體歷史表) [2.1]
    SELECT
        M.名稱,
        M.代號,
        B.成交價 AS 盤中成交價,
        B.漲幅 AS 盤中漲幅,
        B.總量 AS 盤中總量,
        M.專家實戰總分 AS 當前日線分數,
        M.日期,
        M.具體概念,
        K60.Curr_K AS [最新60M_K],
        K60.Curr_D AS [最新60M_D],
        K60.Curr_OSC AS [最新60M_OSC],
        P15.最高勝率 AS [S15_最佳勝率],
        P15.最高勝率天數 AS [S15_最佳天數],
        P30.最高勝率 AS [S30_最佳勝率],
        P30.最佳天數 AS [S30_最佳天數],
        (
            CASE WHEN M.一週庫存比率 > M.二週庫存比率 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN M.二週庫存比率 > M.三週庫存比率 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN M.三週庫存比率 > M.四週庫存比率 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN M.四週庫存比率 > M.五週庫存比率 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN M.五週庫存比率 > M.六週庫存比率 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN M.六週庫存比率 > M.七週庫存比率 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS [股權集中共振次數]
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo AS B ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)

    -- 讀取最新一根 60M 指標 (改用 LEFT JOIN 防禦) [2.1]
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT R1.代號, R1.K AS Curr_K, R1.D AS Curr_D, R1.OSC AS Curr_OSC
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, K, D, OSC,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R1
        WHERE R1.Rn = 1
    ) K60 ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(K60.代號)

    -- 讀取雙向股性 DNA 1-30天回測結果 [2.1]
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_S15 P15 ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(P15.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality P30 ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(P30.代號)

    -- 核心過濾：僅限制成交量大於 500 張
    WHERE B.總量 >= 500
) AS T
-- 2. 關聯週線 MA60 快照 [2.1]
LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(T.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)

-- 3. 關聯 FactSet 機構估值 [2.1]
LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(T.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號)
    AND F.新聞日期 = (SELECT MAX(新聞日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates WHERE 代號 = F.代號)

-- 4. 關聯 AllCross_Snapshot 交叉快照表 [2.1]
LEFT JOIN stockchange.dbo.AllCross_Snapshot AC ON RTRIM(T.代號) = RTRIM(AC.代號)

-- 5. 🛠️【安全對齊優化】：自動讀取快照表該標的最新的一天數據 [2.1]
LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(T.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號)
    AND SCH.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory WHERE 代號 = SCH.代號)

-- 6. 確保資料對齊最新日期 [2.1]
WHERE T.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis)
ORDER BY T.盤中總量 DESC;

# 🏆 本檔案為【50+ 組 SQL 範本 Playwright 動態導入與註解清洗工具 V4.5】
# 內建「註解自動清洗器」，自動剔除 -- 與 /* */ 註解，防止 SSMS 複製時因換行符消失導致的「語法吞噬」死鎖！ [1.1, 2.1]

import os
import re
import time
import html
import pyodbc
import urllib3
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright  # 💡 導入同步版 Playwright 引擎 [1.1]

# 關閉 self-signed SSL 憑證警告
urllib3.disable_warnings(urllib3.exceptions.InsecureRequestWarning)

# ==========================================
# 【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
# 💡 優先使用您已確認通暢的 https duckdns 網域
TARGET_URL = "https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/myword1.html?id=82"

CONN_STR = 'DRIVER={SQL Server};SERVER=pc048000110;DATABASE=stockchangedate;Trusted_Connection=yes'

# ==========================================
# 👑【核心防線】：自動移除所有 SQL 註解，確保資料庫內只存儲乾淨的純 SQL！ [1.1, 2.1]
# ==========================================
def remove_sql_comments(sql_string):
    # 1. 物理移除 /* ... */ 區塊註解 [1.1]
    sql_string = re.sub(r'/\*[\s\S]*?\*/', '', sql_string)
    
    # 2. 逐行處理，精確切割並移除每行 -- 之後的註解，保留前端有效 SQL [1.1]
    lines = sql_string.split('\n')
    clean_lines = []
    for line in lines:
        if '--' in line:
            line = line.split('--')[0]  # 只保留 -- 前半部的有效 T-SQL 代碼 [1.1]
        clean_lines.append(line.rstrip())
        
    # 3. 合併並去除連續的空行，使 SQL 保持極致純淨的純代碼狀態 [1.1]
    return "\n".join([l for l in clean_lines if l.strip() != ""])

def fetch_dynamic_content_via_playwright():
    print(f"🚀 Playwright 正在啟動無頭瀏覽器，前往: {TARGET_URL}")
    try:
        with sync_playwright() as p:
            browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
            context = browser.new_context(ignore_https_errors=True)
            page = context.new_page()
            
            # 開啟網頁並等待網路閒置
            page.goto(TARGET_URL, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=60000)
            
            # 等候 3.5 秒，確保網頁數據完全加載
            print("⏳ 正在等候網頁後台數據加載（AJAX 數據拉取中）...")
            time.sleep(3.5)
            
            # 讀取 textarea 的實際值 [1.1]
            raw_text = page.locator("textarea").input_value()
            
            if not raw_text:
                print("⚠️ textarea 為空，嘗試獲取全網頁內容備援...")
                raw_text = page.content()
                
            browser.close()
            return html.unescape(raw_text)
            
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Playwright 執行期發生異常: {e}")
        return None

def main():
    # 1. 透過 Playwright 取得動態渲染後的文字內容
    decrypted_content = fetch_dynamic_content_via_playwright()
    if not decrypted_content:
        print("❌ 未能成功獲取網頁動態加載後的數據。")
        return

    # 💡 2. 【第一步】：大範圍掃描並抓出所有包含 cat 和 sql 關鍵字的 { ... } 區塊 [1.1]
    block_pattern = re.compile(r'\{[^{}]*?(?:cat|["\']cat["\'])\s*:[\s\S]*?(?:sql|["\']sql["\'])\s*:[\s\S]*?\}', re.DOTALL)
    blocks = block_pattern.findall(decrypted_content)
    
    if not blocks:
        print("\n⚠️ 警告：未能在獲取到的文字中匹配到任何大括號 {} 包裹的範本區塊。")
        return

    matches = []
    
    # 💡 3. 【第二步】：在每個獨立區塊中，單獨提取 cat, title, sql [1.1]
    for block in blocks:
        cat_match = re.search(r'(?:cat|["\']cat["\'])\s*:\s*["\'](.*?)["\']', block)
        title_match = re.search(r'(?:title|["\']title["\'])\s*:\s*["\'](.*?)["\']', block)
        # sql 欄位支援 反引號 (``) 或單雙引號
        sql_match = re.search(r'(?:sql|["\']sql["\'])\s*:\s*(?:`([\s\S]*?)`|["\']([\s\S]*?)["\'])', block)
        
        if cat_match and title_match and sql_match:
            cat = cat_match.group(1).strip()
            title = title_match.group(1).strip()
            # 優先讀取反引號內容，否則讀取單雙引號內容
            sql = sql_match.group(1).strip() if sql_match.group(1) else sql_match.group(2).strip()
            matches.append((cat, title, sql))

    if not matches:
        print("⚠️ 雖抓到大括號區塊，但在區塊內部提取 cat, title 或 sql 欄位時失敗。")
        return

    print(f"📊 成功偵測並提取出 {len(matches)} 組標準 SQL 戰情範本！準備開始清洗並自動化寫入...")
    
    success_count = 0
    fail_count = 0
    
    # 4. 建立資料庫連線並批次寫入 AIEngineeringKB [2.1]
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            
            for item in matches:
                cat = item[0]
                title = item[1]
                sql = item[2]
                
                # 👑【核心優化】：自動物理去除 SQL 中的所有註解，保持 100% 潔淨！ [1.1]
                clean_sql = remove_sql_comments(sql)
                
                # 👑【智慧防呆】：自動偵測並在最前方補齊 SELECT 關鍵字 [1.1, 2.1]
                if not clean_sql.upper().startswith("SELECT") and \
                   not clean_sql.upper().startswith("WITH") and \
                   not clean_sql.upper().startswith("EXEC"):
                    clean_sql = "SELECT " + clean_sql
                
                user_prompt = cat + title
                correct_sql = clean_sql
                
                if not user_prompt or not correct_sql:
                    continue
                
                try:
                    # 呼叫自動進化預存程序進行寫入或增量更新 [2.1]
                    cursor.execute(
                        "EXEC dbo.sp_SaveToAIEngineeringKB @UserPrompt = ?, @CorrectSQL = ?",
                        (user_prompt, correct_sql)
                    )
                    success_count += 1
                except Exception as db_err:
                    print(f"❌ 寫入失敗 -> 需求: {user_prompt} | 錯誤: {db_err}")
                    fail_count += 1
            
            conn.commit()
            
        print("\n" + "=" * 45)
        print(f"🎉 🎉 批次導入完成！結果大捷！")
        print(f"📊 成功寫入/更新：{success_count} 筆範本 (已物理清除所有註解雜質)")
        print(f"⚠️ 失敗：{fail_count} 筆")
        print("=" * 45)
        print("📡 您的 AI 經驗知識庫 [AIEngineeringKB] 已成功充實！且已全量升級為無註解安全版！")
        
    except Exception as conn_err:
        print(f"❌ 資料庫連線失敗 (請確認 SQL Server 已啟動且 ConnString 正確)：{conn_err}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

N''⛈️ 跌破月均分 (中線走弱)'' ELSE N''🟡 震盪整理 (均分糾結)'' END) AS 動能均線診斷 , (CASE WHEN SCH.實戰總分_ma60 >= 10.0 THEN N''☀️ 長線多頭'' WHEN SCH.實戰總分_ma60 BETWEEN 0.0 AND 9.99 THEN N''🌤️ 長線溫和'' ELSE N''⛈️ 長線空頭'' END) AS 長線分數趨勢 , T.最新60M_K, T.最新60M_D, T.最新60M_OSC, W.本週中心 AS 週MA60扣抵 , ROUND(T.盤中成交價 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS 週抗壓比 , F.最新EPS中位數 AS FactSet預估EPS , F.預估目標價 AS 共識目標價 , ROUND(((F.預估目標價 - T.盤中成交價) / NULLIF(T.盤中成交價, 0)) * 100, 1) AS [目標價潛在空間(%)] , T.S15_最佳勝率 AS [S15_最高勝率(%)] , T.S15_最佳天數 AS [S15_最佳持股天數(天)] , T.S30_最佳勝率 AS [S30_最高勝率(%)] , T.S30_最佳天數 AS [S30_最佳持股天數(天)] , SCH.實戰總分黃金交叉次數 AS 實戰總分共振分 , AC.成交價黃金交叉次數 AS 價格共振分 , AC.obv黃金交叉次數 AS OBV共振分 , AC.外資黃金交叉次數 AS 外資共振分 , AC.投信黃金交叉次數 AS 投信共振分 , T.股權集中共振次數 AS 股權共振分 , AC.總量黃金交叉次數 AS 總量共振分 , T.具體概念, T.股本億 FROM ( SELECT M.名稱, M.代號, B.成交價 AS 盤中成交價, B.漲幅 AS 盤中漲幅, B.總量 AS 盤中總量, M.專家實戰總分 AS 當前日線分數, M.日期, M.具體概念, M.股本億, K60.Curr_K AS 最新60M_K , K60.Curr_D AS 最新60M_D , K60.Curr_OSC AS 最新60M_OSC , P15.最高勝率 AS S15_最佳勝率 , P15.最高勝率天數 AS S15_最佳天數 , P30.最高勝率 AS S30_最佳勝率 , P30.最佳天數 AS S30_最佳天數 , ( CASE WHEN M.一週庫存比率 > M.二週庫存比率 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN M.二週庫存比率 > M.三週庫存比率 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN M.三週庫存比率 > M.四週庫存比率 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN M.四週庫存比率 > M.五週庫存比率 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN M.五週庫存比率 > M.六週庫存比率 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN M.六週庫存比率 > M.七週庫存比率 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS 股權集中共振次數 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo AS B ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT R1.代號, R1.K AS Curr_K, R1.D AS Curr_D, R1.OSC AS Curr_OSC FROM ( SELECT 代號, K, D, OSC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M ) R1 WHERE R1.Rn = 1 ) K60 ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(K60.代號) LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_S15 P15 ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(P15.代號) LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality P30 ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(P30.代號) WHERE B.總量 >= 500 ) AS T LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(T.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號) LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(T.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號) AND F.新聞日期 = (SELECT MAX(新聞日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates WHERE 代號 = F.代號) LEFT JOIN stockchange.dbo.AllCross_Snapshot AC ON RTRIM(T.代號) = RTRIM(AC.代號) LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(T.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND SCH.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory WHERE 代號 = SCH.代號) WHERE T.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis) ORDER BY T.盤中總量 DESC;',
    QueryCount = 100,
    LastUsedDate = GETDATE()
WHERE ID = 217;
